complete_chinese: 我以前用有线耳机，但是现在大多数手机基本都没有有线耳机的插孔了，所以我改用无线耳机——它们通过蓝牙连接，而且我觉得实际上更方便。

sentences.en: I used to use wired headphones.
sentences.explanation: “used to + 动词原形”表示过去经常做但现在已经不做的习惯；“wired headphones”是“有线耳机”的常用说法，与“wireless headphones”（无线耳机）相对。
sentences.usage: I used to take the bus to work, but now I ride a bike.

sentences.zh: 但是现在大多数手机基本都没有有线耳机的插孔了，所以我改用无线耳机——它们通过蓝牙连接，而且我觉得实际上更方便。
sentences.en: But these days, most phones just don't have an entrance for wired headphones anymore, so I switched to wireless earphones — they connect through Bluetooth, and it's actually more convenient, I guess.
sentences.explanation: “these days”意为“如今、现在”，常与一般现在时连用；“not... anymore”表示“不再……”；“switch to + 名词”表示“转而使用……”；表达“耳机孔”更自然的搭配是 headphone jack 或 headphone port，entrance 通常指“入口、大门”；“connect through Bluetooth”表示“通过蓝牙连接”，也可说 connect via Bluetooth；句末“I guess”表示“我觉得、我想”，用于缓和语气。
sentences.usage: These days, many people don't carry cash anymore, so shops have switched to mobile payment — it connects through the internet, and it's more convenient, I guess.
